Six functions in `langsmith.ts` call `createRunTree`. Every call passes `run_type` as a fixed string, not a variable.

- **`traceTurn`** calls it five times:
  - `"chain"` at line 253, to create a standalone turn run.
  - `"llm"` at line 307, to create the assistant run.
  - `"tool"` at line 365, for each tool call.
  - `"llm"` at line 414, to patch the assistant run closed.
  - `"chain"` at line 476, to patch the turn run closed.
- **`patchTurnRun`** uses `"chain"` (line 549).
- **`tracePendingSubagents`** uses `"tool"` (line 931).
- **`traceSubagentChain`** uses `"chain"` (line 1034).
- **`closeAgentToolRun`** uses `"tool"` (line 1191).
- **`traceWorkflowStage`** has no direct call inside its own body.
